Understanding Modern AI Architectures

By Dr. Elena Vance | Published on November 20, 2026

Large language models continue to evolve with focused agentic workflows and local reasoning engines.

The Rise of Small Local Models

While massive cloud clusters dominate heavy benchmarks, smaller 8B and 14B parameter models run efficiently on consumer GPUs.

Local-first architectures guarantee privacy and eliminate cloud subscription costs for repetitive tasks.

In conclusion, combining fast client-side extensions with optimized context preparation produces superior developer velocity.
